name: lang-my
title: Burmese (Myanmar) language
summary: Burmese strings for the core and every module, Burmese digits, the language picker in Account, Noto Sans Myanmar and the 2.2× line-height rule for Myanmar text. Copy it as `lang-<code>` for another language with a tall script (Thai, Khmer…).
when: The app ships in Burmese, or as the template for another tall-script language.
claudeRules: Every string exists in Burmese too (`src/modules/lang-my/strings/<module>.ts`; `npm test` fails otherwise). Write Burmese natively, not word by word. Myanmar text keeps lineHeight ≥ 2.2× its font size; inputs pick the Myanmar font from the placeholder as well as the value.
